# tools/test_stream_rs.py effects: stream 2's Func_str0001 run in eemu, one pass a game frame.
# end FRAMEEND; cue STEP PARAM (0x8010 notes, str0001's records)
# step K rand STATE [same]: the pass before the task's Breath on step K (0: the frame before
#   the scene's first), the libc rand state after it; 'same': the draws of step K - 1

#   blend=<none|ALPHA> atest=<off|method/ref/fail> ztest=N zwrite=N scissor=x0,x1,y0,y1
#   v=x,y,z,u,v,rgba per vertex (x, y in 1/16 pixel off XYOFFSET, u, v in 1/16 texel)
end 2040
